en:
(I hate to walk away, but I just don't think I'm ready yet.
I'll come back later!)

Fine. You're on! But if I win, you have to take back what
you said!

Oh, sure. Tell ya what. If by some miracle you do win, I'll
get down on my knees to apologize and everything.
Let's do it, then! I'll show ya what a real pro can do!

Hmph. Ya gave me that big speech about both skills being so
important, and that's all ya got?

Maybe learn how to dance before ya try lecturin' people
again, eh?

(Darn. I'm still no match for her. I'd better train extra
hard and try again later.)

Can you believe that girl? She seriously thinks she's gonna
be a big star someday with mediocre talent like that?

She was doing her best to sing, but she was all outta
breath, and her moves were sloppy, too. I tell ya, that was
some pretty low-level stuff.

And you oughta know. I remember you used to be able to sing
and dance at the same time like it was nothing.

Don't be silly! That was lip-syncing. What else? All these
pre-recorded deals use lip-syncing! Especially idol shows!
Really!? I didn't know that.

There are all kinds of ways to fake it, so it doesn't really
matter how well ya sing. What's really important is the dancing.

And ya can't fake dancing. So if you're gonna be good at one
thing or the other, it better be dancing. That's what people
really notice.

The only people who oughta worry about singing are those who
can already dance.

If singing's the only thing you can do, you're pretty much
screwed.

(Wow, how rude! They're equally important, and we all work
really hard on both!)
I'd like you to take that back!
Oh, it's you. You're Misa's student, right?
That's right. Haruka Sawamura.
Well? Whaddya want?

Do you really believe that all idols use lip-sync, and that
singing skill doesn't really matter?

Of course! When it comes to idols, it's all about the
visual.

You don't amount to nothin' without charisma, no matter how
well ya sing. If you don't have visual appeal, ya might as
well be on the radio.

These kids nowadays have nothing but looks, and dancing's
little more than a game to them. They call themselves
artists! Gimme a break!

I think you're being very disrespectful! The idols I know
are all very serious about both their singing and dancing.
They work very, very hard!
And so do the voice coaches who train them!

Hmph. Whatever. I bet you're just like Misa⑬no confidence
in your dancing abilities, so ya try to make up for it with
singing.

Look, if ya wanna make it on TV, don't waste your time on
all that voice training crap. Just focus on not embarrassing
yourself with mediocre dancing!
Now, if ya don't mind, I'm a little busy.
But I do have confidence in my dancing abilities!

I know I can dance! Idols train really hard in both singing
and dancing! That's just what we do!
Well, well... Those are some pretty feisty words.

How about I put ya to a little test, then? A dance battle,
you against me.

You said you can dance, didn't ya? Or were you just blowin'
smoke?
No, I⑬

Hmph. It's Misa all over again⑬a big mouth, and nothin' to
back it up.

What? Ya come lookin' for a fight, then back out!? Pretty
pathetic, if you ask me...
What are all these people doing here?

I guess somebody's filming some kind of show, but I can't
see a thing through all these people.
A show?

You hadn't come back yet, so I went out to see if I could
find ya and ran into this. Anyway, let's get back to your
lessons.
Oh, look! It's that TV personality, Ayu Kurata!
Ayu Kurata!?
I bet she's taping a variety show or something.
C'mon, let's get outta here. You coming?
Huh? What's the rush⑬
Oh, she's coming this way!
I thought I recognized your voice, Misa.
Ayu. How ya been?
So you're in Tokyo now?

Just here on business. This kiddo's gonna have her debut
concert at the Japan Dome.
How do you do? I'm Haruka Sawamura!
Oh, that's right! You're a voice coach now, aren't ya?

And a student of yours is gonna debut at the Japan Dome?
Hey, that's really something.
Hey, thanks.
Haruka, was it? Aren't you a pretty little face?

I bet a girl like you would do pretty well for herself in
this industry. Unlike some people.

After all, you could be the best singer in the world, but if
you ain't pretty or a people person, you're not gonna get
any work, are ya?
That's enough, Ayu!
Kurata-san! We're moving to Theater Square now!
Well, I'll be seeing ya.
Yamaura-san, do you and Ayu Kurata know each other?
Yeah... She was my partner back when I was a singer.
Your partner!?
Yeah. We're talkin' ten years ago.

We belonged to the same talent agency, so they decided to
stick us together as a duo.
You were in a duo with Ayu Kurata?

It's no surprise ya didn't know. That info'd be little more
than a "Do You Remember When?" blurb in a magazine nowadays.

Ayu was pretty and a good dancer, but she couldn't sing. I
was a good singer, but I couldn't dance and was ugly. That's
what people said, anyway.
That's terrible!

We were a bad combination from the start. No matter how well
I sang, the only things people noticed were Ayu's looks and
her great moves.

After a while, she started getting offered gigs on her own,
and our little duo came to a standstill.
Then one thing led to another, and, well, here we are.
I had no idea...

Personally, I think Ayu's a real piece of work, but I gotta
hand it to her⑬she sure does have "it."
"It"?

That's right. Ya see, a good singing voice or fluid dance
moves⑬that's all stuff that can be learned.

But if you really wanna steal the spotlight, you gotta have
that certain star quality, the oh-so-elusive "it" factor.

And that's not something you can learn. I just didn't have
it... Sorry if it sounds like I'm making excuses for myself.
That said, Haruka, you have "it."
So don't let your chance slip away!

Don't let somebody like Ayu come along and steal your work
from under you. I don't want ya to fade away like I did!

Anyway, that's ancient history. Let's get back to the
studio!

I saw some guy walkin' toward Iwao Bridge with this crazy
look on his face, almost like he had nothin' left to lose.
He looked like he was about ready to rob or kill someone.

Hey, that guy walkin' toward the taxi stand... Was he
holdin' a knife?
No, that can't be right. Musta been somethin' else.
This table is for high-stakes blackjack. You can play for as little as 100 chips a hand. Would you like to play?
Would you like to review the rules?
test２。
test１。
They say the road will be clear enough to travel on soon, even for taxis.
Hey, you're Saejima-san, right?
You hear the news? The road to town's finally open again.
They said the road will be clear enough for taxis soon.
And really, there's no reason for you to be here anymore. You should think about heading out.
You gotta be kidding me. That man-eating bear's back?
Somebody's got to make Okudera stop provoking it!
Hey, did you hear? Okudera's hurt. Yama-oroshi finally got him, eh?
Yeah. Probably.
Hey, I'll be honest with you⑬you probably shouldn't get too involved with Okudera.
Hey, are you the guy staying with Okudera?
Yeah, he found me on the mountain last night. I was real lost.
Dang. That must've sucked.
Tell me... does everyone here have somethin' against Okudera-han?
Heck yeah. The village went through all kinds of shit because of him.
Well, nothing that concerns you.
Look, I'll be honest with you⑬you probably shouldn't get too involved with Okudera.
Ah, you're the one staying at Okudera-san's.
Perhaps you've heard... the road is finally open again.
But you'll need to watch yourself if you travel on it... People are saying Yama-oroshi's nearby.
And there are children here. Frightening, isn't it?
Ah, you must be the man staying with Okudera-san.
Yeah. Prob'ly be stayin' here a while.
So you're gonna do just what Okudera did ten years ago. He was lost in these here woods, and one of us found him and brought him back to the village.
Yup, just like you. The fellow who found him went by the name of Sato. In fact, it's Sato's house that Okudera now lives in!
Tch, he's basically a squatter...
All these damned blizzards have closed down the road. We're cut off from the rest of the world right now.
So we can't go into town to buy food, and we can't hunt any more game 'cause the bears are killing them all. Don't know why the bears aren't hibernating as much this winter...
Hey, Saejima. How goes the hunting?
So-so, I'd say.
Knowing that you and Okudera hunt together is a huge relief to all of us.
It's terrible.
Well... it's all about practice, you know. Just keep trying; don't get discouraged.
Don't beat yourself up over mistakes when you're still new at it.
Are you ready to go to the mountain?
Nah, I ain't ready yet.
Okay. Tell me when you are.
Sure thing.
Yup, I'm headin' out.

When heading to the mountain, you get a special <Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag
that holds gear and supplies specifically for that trip.
Check the <Color:7>Equipment screen<Color:Default> before you set off!

To bring an item with you to the mountain, move it to the <Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag
on your <Color:7>Equipment screen<Color:Default>. Deer meat would be good to bring,
so don't forget to put that into the <Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag!

If you cancel an outing to the mountain, any items you
already put in your bag will be moved to the <Color:7>Item Box<Color:Default>.
Okay, you take care out there.
Wait, after all the trouble you went through to get it, you're not going to take any food with you? Look, being out in the cold saps your strength. You'll need nourishment!
Wait, Saejima, don't you have any deer meat?
Well, that won't do! Here, take this.
How did it go? Did he lend you a gun?
Nah. Got turned down.
Thought so. Honestly, you should just give up. But since I know you won't...
You got Simple Cold Wear.
You got a Horizontal Double Rifle.
Where'd you get this gun?
Nishina-san dropped it off, actually. He doesn't want to lend you a rifle, but he wants you going up there unarmed even less.
What's his deal, anyway?
It's not your concern right now. So, are you gonna do what you said you'd do, and go to the mountain?

To bring an item with you to the mountain, move it to the
<Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag on your <Color:7>Equipment screen<Color:Default>. Deer meat would be good to bring,
so don't forget to put that into the <Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag!

To bring an item with you to the mountain, move it to the
<Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag on your <Color:7>Equipment screen<Color:Default>. You can switch
between the Item Box and your Inventory with <Action:Button_L1@Hunter_And_Killer> and <Action:Button_R1@Hunter_And_Killer>.
Don't forget to pack some deer meat in your <Color:7>snow gear<Color:Default> bag!
His wife might be okay with lending it to you, but I don't know about Nishina-san himself... Might as well ask, though.
Think I'm gonna go into the wild.
You're going after Okudera-san, aren't you?
Yeah... but also I'm gonna start huntin' on my own.
Wow. Really?
Nishina's wife was kind enough to share some food. I'm gonna repay her by catchin' some wild game.
Good luck...
Hey, if ya wanna be helpful, ya got a gun I can borrow?
Hah. Before that, there's your clothes to deal with. You can't hunt wearing that⑬every animal's gonna see you from a mile away!
Well, what should I do?
Hmm... I might have something in storage if you don't mind it being old. You won't look stylish, that's for sure.
That don't matter. Be great if I could borrow it.
Sure. That just leaves the gun...
Ya got anythin'?
As much as I'd like to help you, I only have one rifle. And I'm a hunter... We never allow ourselves to be without a gun.
I seem to remember Nishina-san having an extra one, though.
But who knows if he'd let you borrow it? His wife would be okay with it, but as for him... Well, he's not on great terms with Okudera-san right now.
Only one way to find out.
True. Go ask him, and in the meantime I'll look for the clothes.
You wanna head to the mountain? Or do you need more time?
Not quite ready yet. Soon, though.
Tell me when you're ready. I'll be waiting here.
Okay. Be careful out there, Saejima. Whatever you do, stay near the river.
Hey. Did you manage to find some food?
Yeah. Someone was kind enough to share.
